title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Copperline Laboratory Services under your health plan for services provided on August 22, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Reason for denial: This claim duplicates a claim we have already processed for the same service and date. Reason code: CO-18.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $2,414.35 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $2,414.35.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: Your written appeal must be received by March 25, 2027. Send it to Hollis Creek Health, Appeals Unit, PO Box 1337, Macon, GA 31201. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-0623.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
